title: Climate Risk and Capital Structure
eligible_reason: Treatment is a continuous forward-looking physical climate-risk score (CRISrating or FourTwentySevenrating) interacted with a common Post-2015 (Paris Agreement) dummy. Table 4 uses a binary HighClimateRisk x Post2015, but with the same single date. Every column includes time-varying firm controls (EBIT, LogAge, TobinQ, OpEx, RDExp, LogTotAssets, PPE, oilbeta, CreditRating). No staggered adoption.
design_notes: do file firm year data.do: areg BookLev ... CRISrating CRISratingxPost2015 i.DataYearFiscal, absorb(gvkey) vce(cluster gvkey), plus pooled OLS with country x industry FE and xtivreg columns instrumenting CreditRating. Bond and bank loan files use the same Post2015 interaction at the issue level with many loan-level controls.
n_eligible_specs_note: Single date; continuous treatment; time-varying controls.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Post = fiscal year > 2015 for all firms.
